# PCA 

```{r}
setwd("/Users/itamartalpaz/GitHub/rat_protozoa_infection_profiles/")

#############


G4_long_otu <- read.csv("data/data_processed/G4_long_otu.csv")
G4_wide_otu <- read.csv("data/data_processed/G4_wide_otu.csv") # full network, first col is ID
G4_taxonomy <- read.csv("data/data_processed/G4_taxonomy.csv")

metadata <- read_csv("data/data_processed/rat_metadata.csv") 

# taking only hosts we have protozoa and metadata information
hosts <- intersect(G4_long_otu$host_ID, metadata$host_ID)
G4_long_otu <- G4_long_otu %>% 
  filter(host_ID %in% hosts)

## un-infected hosts are excluded from this analysis and are pre-defined as a distinct group

# hosts with no infection
group_zero <- G4_long_otu %>% 
  group_by(host_ID) %>% 
  summarise(n = sum(link)) %>%
  filter(n==0) %>% 
  mutate(host_group = 1) %>% 
  select(-n)

pmat <- G4_long_otu %>% # only infected
  select(host_ID, otu_ID, link) %>%
  filter(!(host_ID %in% group_zero$host_ID)) %>%
  spread(otu_ID, link, fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("host_ID") %>% 
  as.matrix()

# sbm_fit.RData read this

load("data/data_results/sbm_fit.RData")
# Select the best number of clusters (based on maximum likelihood)
best_run <- which.max(sbm_fit$ICL)

# host sbm-membership
memb_host <- as.data.frame(sbm_fit$memberships[[best_run]]$Z1) %>%
  mutate(host_group = max.col(.,'first')+1) %>% 
  mutate(host_ID = as.double(rownames(pmat))) %>% # attaching hosts IDs
  dplyr::select(host_ID,host_group) %>% 
  bind_rows(group_zero)  # adding the uninfected group

# protozoa sbm-membership
memb_otu <- as.data.frame(sbm_fit$memberships[[best_run]]$Z2) %>%
  mutate(otu_group = max.col(.,'first')) %>% 
  mutate(otu_ID = as.numeric(colnames(pmat))) %>%
  select(otu_group,otu_ID)

```

```{r}
#############
## PCA (FULL matrix incl. uninfected) + plot with top-5 parasite loadings

library(vegan)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)

# Build FULL host x otu matrix INCLUDING uninfected hosts
pmat_full <- G4_long_otu %>%
  select(host_ID, otu_ID, link) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = otu_ID, values_from = link, values_fill = 0) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("host_ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Align host membership (memb_host) with matrix rownames
memb_host2 <- memb_host %>%
  mutate(host_ID_chr = as.character(host_ID),
         host_group  = factor(host_group)) %>%
  select(host_ID_chr, host_group)

common_hosts <- intersect(rownames(pmat_full), memb_host2$host_ID_chr)
pmat_full <- pmat_full[common_hosts, , drop = FALSE]

meta_pca <- memb_host2 %>%
  filter(host_ID_chr %in% common_hosts) %>%
  arrange(match(host_ID_chr, rownames(pmat_full)))

stopifnot(all(meta_pca$host_ID_chr == rownames(pmat_full)))

# Hellinger transform + PCA (vegan::rda)
pmat_hell <- decostand(pmat_full, method = "hellinger")
pca_full  <- rda(pmat_hell)

# Site scores (hosts) and merge groups
df_sites <- scores(pca_full, display = "sites", choices = 1:2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("host_ID_chr")

colnames(df_sites)[colnames(df_sites) == "RDA1"] <- "PC1"
colnames(df_sites)[colnames(df_sites) == "RDA2"] <- "PC2"

df_sites <- df_sites %>%
  left_join(meta_pca, by = "host_ID_chr")

# Percent variance explained (PC1/PC2)
eig <- eigenvals(pca_full)
var_expl <- eig / sum(eig)
pc1 <- round(100 * var_expl[1], 1)
pc2 <- round(100 * var_expl[2], 1)

# Base PCA plot (sites)
p_full <- ggplot(df_sites, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = host_group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of host infection profiles (FULL matrix incl. uninfected)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2, "%)"),
    color = "host_group"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

# ---- Parasite loadings (top 5) with otu_ID + taxonomy final_id ----

# Species scores (parasites)
sp <- scores(pca_full, display = "species", choices = 1:2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("otu_colname")

colnames(sp)[colnames(sp) == "RDA1"] <- "PC1"
colnames(sp)[colnames(sp) == "RDA2"] <- "PC2"

# Robust OTU id handling (works for columns like "123" or "X123")
sp <- sp %>%
  mutate(
    otu_ID_chr = otu_colname,
    otu_ID_num = readr::parse_number(otu_colname)
  )

# Join taxonomy (expects G4_taxonomy with columns: otu_ID, final_id)
# If you don't have G4_taxonomy loaded, labels will fall back to otu_ID_chr
if (exists("G4_taxonomy")) {
  tax2 <- G4_taxonomy %>%
    mutate(otu_ID_num = readr::parse_number(as.character(otu_ID))) %>%
    select(otu_ID_num, final_id) %>%
    distinct()

  sp <- sp %>%
    left_join(tax2, by = "otu_ID_num") %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(final_id),
                          otu_ID_chr,
                          paste0(otu_ID_chr, " (", final_id, ")")))
} else {
  sp <- sp %>% mutate(label = otu_ID_chr)
}

# Scale arrows into the site-score space (robust manual scaling)
site_range <- apply(df_sites[, c("PC1","PC2")], 2, range, na.rm = TRUE)
sp_range   <- apply(sp[, c("PC1","PC2")], 2, range, na.rm = TRUE)

arrow_mult <- min(
  diff(site_range[, "PC1"]) / diff(sp_range[, "PC1"]),
  diff(site_range[, "PC2"]) / diff(sp_range[, "PC2"])
) * 0.7

sp <- sp %>%
  mutate(
    PC1s = PC1 * arrow_mult,
    PC2s = PC2 * arrow_mult,
    vec_len = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2)
  )

# Keep EXACTLY top 5 (no ties)
sp_top <- sp %>% slice_max(vec_len, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

# Final plot: arrows start at (0,0)
p_full_loadings <- p_full +
  geom_segment(
    data = sp_top,
    aes(xend = PC1s, yend = PC2s),
    x = 0, y = 0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = sp_top,
    aes(x = PC1s, y = PC2s, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  )

print(p_full_loadings)

```

```{r}
#############
## PCA (infected only) + k-means (k=2) on PC1/PC2 + overlap vs SBM + top-5 loadings
#############

library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(ggrepel)

# --- 1) Build infected-only host x otu matrix (exclude uninfected hosts) ---
infected_hosts <- memb_host %>%
  mutate(host_ID_chr = as.character(host_ID)) %>%
  filter(host_group != 1) %>%
  pull(host_ID_chr)

pmat_inf <- G4_long_otu %>%
  mutate(host_ID_chr = as.character(host_ID)) %>%
  filter(host_ID_chr %in% infected_hosts) %>%
  select(host_ID_chr, otu_ID, link) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = otu_ID, values_from = link, values_fill = 0) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("host_ID_chr") %>%
  as.matrix()

# infected-only SBM labels (should be 2 groups: e.g. 2 and 3)
meta_inf <- memb_host %>%
  mutate(host_ID_chr = as.character(host_ID),
         host_group = factor(host_group)) %>%
  filter(host_ID_chr %in% rownames(pmat_inf), host_group != "1") %>%
  arrange(match(host_ID_chr, rownames(pmat_inf)))

stopifnot(all(meta_inf$host_ID_chr == rownames(pmat_inf)))

# --- 2) PCA on infected only (Hellinger + vegan::rda) ---
pmat_inf_hell <- decostand(pmat_inf, method = "hellinger")
pca_inf <- rda(pmat_inf_hell)

# Host (site) scores
df_sites_inf <- scores(pca_inf, display = "sites", choices = 1:2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("host_ID_chr")

colnames(df_sites_inf)[colnames(df_sites_inf) == "RDA1"] <- "PC1"
colnames(df_sites_inf)[colnames(df_sites_inf) == "RDA2"] <- "PC2"

df_sites_inf <- df_sites_inf %>%
  left_join(meta_inf, by = "host_ID_chr")

# % variance explained
eig <- eigenvals(pca_inf)
var_expl <- eig / sum(eig)
pc1 <- round(100 * var_expl[1], 1)
pc2 <- round(100 * var_expl[2], 1)

# --- 3) k-means on PC1 + PC2 (k=2) ---
set.seed(123)
km_res <- kmeans(df_sites_inf[, c("PC1", "PC2")], centers = 2, nstart = 50)

df_km <- df_sites_inf %>%
  mutate(kmeans_group = factor(km_res$cluster))

# --- 4) Overlap: SBM vs k-means ---
overlap_table <- table(SBM = df_km$host_group, KMEANS = df_km$kmeans_group)
print(overlap_table)

agreement_1 <- sum(diag(overlap_table)) / sum(overlap_table)
agreement_2 <- sum(diag(overlap_table[, rev(colnames(overlap_table))])) / sum(overlap_table)
best_agreement <- max(agreement_1, agreement_2)

cat("Best possible agreement between SBM and k-means:", round(best_agreement, 3), "\n")

# --- 5) Parasite loadings (top 5) for the infected-only PCA ---
sp <- scores(pca_inf, display = "species", choices = 1:2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("otu_colname")

colnames(sp)[colnames(sp) == "RDA1"] <- "PC1"
colnames(sp)[colnames(sp) == "RDA2"] <- "PC2"

# Robust OTU id handling (works for "123" or "X123" column names)
sp <- sp %>%
  mutate(
    otu_ID_chr = otu_colname,
    otu_ID_num = readr::parse_number(otu_colname)
  )

# Join taxonomy if available (expects: G4_taxonomy with otu_ID, final_id)
if (exists("G4_taxonomy")) {
  tax2 <- G4_taxonomy %>%
    mutate(otu_ID_num = readr::parse_number(as.character(otu_ID))) %>%
    select(otu_ID_num, final_id) %>%
    distinct()

  sp <- sp %>%
    left_join(tax2, by = "otu_ID_num") %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(final_id),
                          otu_ID_chr,
                          paste0(otu_ID_chr, " (", final_id, ")")))
} else {
  sp <- sp %>% mutate(label = otu_ID_chr)
}

# Scale arrows into the site-score space (manual robust scaling)
site_range <- apply(df_km[, c("PC1","PC2")], 2, range, na.rm = TRUE)
sp_range   <- apply(sp[, c("PC1","PC2")], 2, range, na.rm = TRUE)

arrow_mult <- min(
  diff(site_range[, "PC1"]) / diff(sp_range[, "PC1"]),
  diff(site_range[, "PC2"]) / diff(sp_range[, "PC2"])
) * 0.7

sp <- sp %>%
  mutate(
    PC1s = PC1 * arrow_mult,
    PC2s = PC2 * arrow_mult,
    vec_len = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2)
  )

sp_top <- sp %>% slice_max(vec_len, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

# --- 6) Plot: hosts + (SBM color, kmeans shape) + top-5 parasite loadings ---
p_km_load <- ggplot(df_km, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = host_group, shape = kmeans_group), size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_segment(
    data = sp_top,
    aes(xend = PC1s, yend = PC2s),
    x = 0, y = 0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = sp_top,
    aes(x = PC1s, y = PC2s, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "k-means (k=2) on PCA (infected hosts only) + top-10 parasite loadings",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2, "%)"),
    color = "SBM host group",
    shape = "k-means cluster"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p_km_load)

```

# SBM analysis




```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(blockmodels)

## 1) Keep only hosts we have protozoa + metadata information (same as you do)
hosts <- intersect(G4_long_otu$host_ID, metadata$host_ID)
G4_long_otu2 <- G4_long_otu %>%
  filter(host_ID %in% hosts)

## 2) Identify Tritrichomonas OTUs from taxonomy
## OPTION A (most common for your case): final_id contains the genus name
tritrich_otus <- G4_taxonomy %>%
  filter(str_detect(final_id, regex("Tritrichomonas", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  pull(otu_ID) %>%
  unique()

## If your taxonomy has a genus column instead, use e.g.:
# tritrich_otus <- G4_taxonomy %>% filter(genus == "Tritrichomonas") %>% pull(otu_ID) %>% unique()

## 3) Filter the long table to Tritrichomonas OTUs only
G4_long_tri <- G4_long_otu2 %>%
  filter(otu_ID %in% tritrich_otus)

## 4) Define "uninfected" for THIS SUBNETWORK (no Tritrichomonas infection)
group_zero_tri <- G4_long_tri %>%
  group_by(host_ID) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(link), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n == 0) %>%
  mutate(host_group = 1) %>%
  select(host_ID, host_group)

## 5) Host × Tritrichomonas-OTU matrix (infected hosts only)
pmat_tri <- G4_long_tri %>%
  select(host_ID, otu_ID, link) %>%
  filter(!(host_ID %in% group_zero_tri$host_ID)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = otu_ID, values_from = link, values_fill = 0) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("host_ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

## Optional: drop OTUs with zero prevalence among infected hosts (can break fitting)
pmat_tri <- pmat_tri[, colSums(pmat_tri) > 0, drop = FALSE]

## 6) Run SBM (LBM Bernoulli) on Tritrichomonas-only network
set.seed(123)
sbm_fit_tri <- blockmodels::BM_bernoulli(pmat_tri, membership_type = "LBM")
sbm_fit_tri$plotting <- ""
sbm_fit_tri$estimate()

best_run_tri <- which.max(sbm_fit_tri$ICL)

## 7) Extract memberships (hosts + OTUs)
memb_host_tri <- as.data.frame(sbm_fit_tri$memberships[[best_run_tri]]$Z1) %>%
  mutate(host_group = max.col(., "first") + 1) %>%  # +1 so your "1" stays reserved for uninfected
  mutate(host_ID = as.double(rownames(pmat_tri))) %>%
  select(host_ID, host_group) %>%
  bind_rows(group_zero_tri)  # add uninfected-for-tritrich as group 1

memb_otu_tri <- as.data.frame(sbm_fit_tri$memberships[[best_run_tri]]$Z2) %>%
  mutate(otu_group = max.col(., "first")) %>%
  mutate(otu_ID = as.numeric(gsub("^X", "", colnames(pmat_tri)))) %>%  # handles X123 column names
  select(otu_group, otu_ID)

## 8) (Optional) quick check plot from blockmodels
community_tri <- sbm_fit_tri$memberships[[best_run_tri]]
community_tri$plot()

```


```{r}
#############
## Combine long data with Tritrichomonas SBM memberships

lon_tri <- G4_long_tri %>%
  left_join(memb_host_tri, by = "host_ID") %>%
  left_join(memb_otu_tri, by = "otu_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    host_group = as.factor(host_group),
    otu_group  = as.factor(otu_group)
  )
#############
## Pi matrix (link probabilities between host × Tritrichomonas OTU groups)

# only realized links
lon_tri_links <- lon_tri %>%
  filter(link == 1)

# empirical link counts
link_table_tri <- table(lon_tri_links$host_group, lon_tri_links$otu_group)

link_df_tri <- as.data.frame(as.table(link_table_tri)) %>%
  mutate(
    host_group = as.numeric(Var1),
    otu_group  = as.numeric(Var2)
  ) %>%
  select(-Var1, -Var2)

# SBM-estimated pi matrix
p_tri <- as.data.frame(sbm_fit_tri$model_parameters[[best_run_tri]]$pi) %>%
  rownames_to_column("host_group") %>%
  mutate(host_group = as.numeric(host_group) + 1) %>%   # +1 for uninfected group
  gather("otu_group", "pi", starts_with("V")) %>%
  mutate(otu_group = as.numeric(gsub(".*?([0-9]+).*", "\\1", otu_group))) %>%
  right_join(link_df_tri, by = c("host_group", "otu_group")) %>%
  mutate(
    pi = ifelse(is.na(pi), 0, pi),
    host_group = as.factor(host_group),
    otu_group  = as.factor(otu_group)
  )
# number of hosts per host group
count_host_tri <- memb_host_tri %>%
  group_by(host_group) %>%
  count() %>%
  mutate(
    host_group = as.character(host_group),
    host_group_count = paste0(host_group, " (n = ", n, ")")
  ) %>%
  select(host_group, host_group_count)

# number of OTUs per OTU group
count_otu_tri <- memb_otu_tri %>%
  group_by(otu_group) %>%
  count() %>%
  mutate(
    otu_group = as.character(otu_group),
    otu_group_count = paste0(otu_group, " (n = ", n, ")")
  ) %>%
  select(otu_group, otu_group_count)
pi_plot_tri <- p_tri %>%
  left_join(count_host_tri, by = "host_group") %>%
  left_join(count_otu_tri, by = "otu_group") %>%
  mutate(Label = paste0(round(pi, 3), "\n(", Freq, ")")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = host_group_count,
    y = otu_group_count,
    fill = pi,
    label = Label
  )) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#efedf5", high = "#807dba") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Host Tritrichomonas infection profile",
    y = "Tritrichomonas OTU profile",
    fill = "Link probability"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.6) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

pi_plot_tri
#############
## OTU degree distribution (Tritrichomonas)

gg_otu_tri <- lon_tri %>%
  filter(link == 1) %>%
  group_by(otu_ID, otu_group) %>%
  summarise(prevalence = n_distinct(host_ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = prevalence, fill = otu_group)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "black") +

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),

  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Tritrichomonas OTU degree",
    x = "OTU prevalence (no. hosts)",
    y = "No. of OTUs",
    fill = "OTU profile"
  )

gg_otu_tri
#############
## Host degree distribution (Tritrichomonas richness)

lon_tri_richness <- lon_tri %>%
  group_by(host_ID, host_group) %>%
  summarise(richness = sum(link), .groups = "drop")

gg_host_tri <- lon_tri_richness %>%

gg_host_tri
library(ggpubr)
```

# shuffling

```{r}
shuffle_matrix <- function(mat) {
  m <- mat
  m[] <- sample(m)   # permute all entries
  m
}
# Observed SBM as baseline (already fitted earlier)
best_obs <- which.max(sbm_fit$ICL)

obs_K_host <- ncol(sbm_fit$memberships[[best_obs]]$Z1)
obs_K_otu  <- ncol(sbm_fit$memberships[[best_obs]]$Z2)

obs_host_membership <- max.col(sbm_fit$memberships[[best_obs]]$Z1)

```

```{r}
library(blockmodels)
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(123)
n_perm <- 100

perm_results <- vector("list", n_perm)

for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {

  cat("Permutation", i, "\n")

  # Shuffle links
  pmat_shuf <- shuffle_matrix(pmat)

  # Fit SBM
  sbm_shuf <- BM_bernoulli(pmat_shuf, membership_type = "LBM")
  sbm_shuf$plotting <- ""
  sbm_shuf$estimate()

  best_run <- which.max(sbm_shuf$ICL)

  perm_results[[i]] <- list(
    K_host = ncol(sbm_shuf$memberships[[best_run]]$Z1),
    K_otu  = ncol(sbm_shuf$memberships[[best_run]]$Z2),
    host_membership = max.col(sbm_shuf$memberships[[best_run]]$Z1)
  )
}

```

```{r}

    ),
  ggplot(df_K, aes(K_otu)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "grey70", color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = obs_K_otu, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = "Null distribution of SBM OTU groups",
      subtitle = "Red line = observed network",
      x = "Number of OTU groups",
      y = "Frequency"
    ),
  ncol = 2
)
```

# old code


```{r}
setwd("/Users/itamartalpaz/GitHub/rat_protozoa_infection_profiles/")

```


```{r creating matrix, include=FALSE}
# load the host-protozoa data
G4_long_otu <- read_csv("../data/data_processed/G4_long_otu.csv") 

# metadata
metadata <- read_csv("../data/data_processed/rat_metadata.csv") 

# taking only hosts we have protozoa and metadata information
hosts <- intersect(G4_long_otu$host_ID, metadata$host_ID)
G4_long_otu <- G4_long_otu %>% 
  filter(host_ID %in% hosts)

## un-infected hosts are excluded from this analysis and are pre-defined as a distinct group

# hosts with no infection
group_zero <- G4_long_otu %>% 
  group_by(host_ID) %>% 
  summarise(n = sum(link)) %>%
  filter(n==0) %>% 
  mutate(host_group = 1) %>% 
  select(-n)

# transforming to matrix
# only infected hosts
pmat <- G4_long_otu %>% 
  select(host_ID, otu_ID, link) %>%
  filter(!(host_ID %in% group_zero$host_ID)) %>%
  spread(otu_ID, link, fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("host_ID") %>% 
  as.matrix()

```

```{r Running host-protozoa SBM, include=FALSE}
# Latent Block Model
set.seed(123)
sbm_fit <- blockmodels::BM_bernoulli(pmat, membership_type = "LBM")
sbm_fit$plotting <- '' # Set plots of the convergence process to off
sbm_fit$estimate()

# saving the SBM results
save(sbm_fit,file="../data/data_results/sbm_fit.RData")

# Select the best number of clusters (based on maximum likelihood)
best_run <- which.max(sbm_fit$ICL)

# Extract the community memberships
community_assignments <- sbm_fit$memberships[[best_run]]
community_assignments$plot()
```

```{r extracting group membership and creating dataset for the model, include=FALSE}
# host sbm-membership
memb_host <- as.data.frame(sbm_fit$memberships[[best_run]]$Z1) %>%
  mutate(host_group = max.col(.,'first')+1) %>% 
  mutate(host_ID = as.double(rownames(pmat))) %>% # attaching hosts IDs
  dplyr::select(host_ID,host_group) %>% 
  bind_rows(group_zero)  # adding the uninfected group

# protozoa sbm-membership
memb_otu <- as.data.frame(sbm_fit$memberships[[best_run]]$Z2) %>%
  mutate(otu_group = max.col(.,'first')) %>% 
  mutate(otu_ID = as.numeric(colnames(pmat))) %>%
  select(otu_group,otu_ID)
```

## SBM figure

```{r}
axis_text_size <- 8
title_text_size <- 10

# combining the dataframes
lon <- G4_long_otu %>%
  left_join(memb_host, by = "host_ID") %>%
  left_join(memb_otu, by = "otu_ID") %>%
  mutate(host_group = as.factor(host_group),
         otu_group = as.factor(otu_group))

# average host degree
host_degree <- lon %>% 
  group_by(host_group, host_ID) %>% 
  summarise(n = sum(link)) %>% 
  group_by(host_group) %>% 
  summarise(maximum = max(n), minimum = min(n), average = mean(n))

# average OTU degree
otu_degree <- lon %>% 
  group_by(otu_group, otu_ID) %>% 
  summarise(n = sum(link)) %>% 
  group_by(otu_group) %>% 
  summarise(maximum = max(n), minimum = min(n), average = mean(n)/841*100)
```

```{r pi matrix}
lon_links <- lon %>%
  dplyr::filter(link == 1)

# calculating number of links between host and protozoa profiles
link_table <- table(lon_links$host_group, lon_links$otu_group)

# Convert the table into a data frame
link_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(link_table)) %>%
  mutate(host_group = as.numeric(Var1)) %>%
  mutate(otu_group = as.numeric(Var2)) %>%
  select(-Var1,-Var2)

# adding pi from the model (the probability of a link between the groups in the network)
# adding the uninfected group with 0s
p <- as.data.frame(sbm_fit$model_parameters[[best_run]]$pi) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("host_group") %>% 
  mutate(host_group = as.numeric(host_group)+1) %>%
  gather("otu_group", "pi", starts_with("V")) %>% 
  mutate(otu_group = as.numeric(gsub(".*?([0-9]+).*", "\\1", otu_group))) %>%
  right_join(link_df, by = c("host_group","otu_group")) %>%
  mutate(pi = ifelse(is.na(pi),0,pi)) %>% 
  mutate(host_group = as.factor(host_group)) %>%
  mutate(otu_group = as.factor(otu_group))

# number of host individuals in every host profile
count_host <- memb_host %>%
  group_by(host_group) %>%
  count() %>%
  mutate(host_group = as.character(host_group)) %>%
  mutate(host_group_count = paste(host_group," (n = ",n,")",sep = "")) %>%
  select(host_group_count,host_group)

# number of OTUs in every protozoa profile
count_otu <- memb_otu %>%
  group_by(otu_group) %>%
  count() %>%
  mutate(otu_group = as.character(otu_group)) %>%
  mutate(otu_group_count = paste(otu_group," (n = ",n,")",sep = "")) %>%
  select(otu_group_count,otu_group)

# plotting
#pdf('../../results/figures/fig_sbm_pi.pdf')
 pi_plot <- p %>%
  left_join(count_host, by = "host_group") %>%
  left_join(count_otu, by = "otu_group") %>%
  mutate(
    Label = paste0(round(pi, 3), "\n(", Freq, ")")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = host_group_count,
             y = otu_group_count,
             fill = pi,
             label = Label)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(color = "black", size = 3) +  
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#efedf5", high = "#807dba") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = title_text_size, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size, color = 'black'),
    title = element_text(size = title_text_size),
    legend.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
    legend.title = element_text(size = title_text_size),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Host infection profile", y = "Protozoa infection profile", fill = "Link probability") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.5)
#dev.off()
pi_plot

```
